category: cron job, heartbeat and uptime monitoring with status pages and web analytics (hosted)

free_tier.stated: Hacker plan, free forever at USD 0: 5 monitors (jobs, checks and heartbeats) with a fastest check frequency of 5 minutes, 100,000 web analytics and error events free, 1 status page with 50 subscribers, 1 dashboard user, email and Slack alerts; no SMS alerts and no premium integrations
free_tier.notes: The unit counted is the monitor. The Business plan is USD 2 a month per monitor plus USD 5 a month per user, with a 14-day free trial.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-ping or per-event size is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: the Hacker retention is not stated on the pricing page, which lists 12 months of data retention for the Business plan

egress.terms: not applicable: an inbound telemetry and outbound check service; data is read back through the REST API, which is rate limited with a 429 answer

interface_detail: A REST API at cronitor.io/api authenticated by HTTP basic auth with an API key as the username, with an OpenAPI 3 description; a Telemetry API on cronitor.link takes a key in the URL; every account starts with a telemetry key and an SDK integration key. An MCP server and CronitorCLI expose the same resources. Whether the API is open to the Hacker plan without a request cap is unverified: the pricing page lists unlimited API requests for Business only.
tooling: CronitorCLI, the Telemetry API, the REST API with an OpenAPI description, an MCP server and the web app
chaining: Heartbeat and cron monitoring for up to 5 jobs of free hosts with a status page, plus 100,000 web analytics and error events a month.
